Funding availability reduces one financing uncertainty while construction, rack delivery, customer concentration, debt service and utilization remain separate execution risks.

One volatile session cannot establish long-run value; NVIDIA guidance, leadership transition and Anthropic infrastructure commitments require separate scenario analysis.

actions.title: 上場株式：AI売上の急増とリスク許容度の低下が重なる
